mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment growth signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of months when PAYEMS growth is positive, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals an overheating labor market that increases the probability of Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of months when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in industrial production signals accommodative monetary policy supporting robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom regime (HOUST > 1250), strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 500000) signals an overheating economy that increases monetary tightening risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST>1250 and RSAFS>500000, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production growth signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of quarters when INDPRO growth is positive, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts signals a cooling housing market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of days when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and consumer spending signals a broad-based economic slowdown that increases recession risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
